{{Top|leg}}
A '''false energy signature projector''' was a device that fooled [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. [[Leger DeMain]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]], ''[[Siren III]]'' had a fake engine that doubled as a secret cargo hold. He used [[Illuminator/Legends|illuminators]] and a false energy signature projector to project the illusion that it was a working engine.
